messages.content: Plan a small project with 7 tasks. Give a concise approach that checks assumptions and dependencies.

1. Define the result and acceptance checks.
2. List the 7 tasks and mark dependencies.
3. Prioritize the smallest complete user flow.
4. Test edge cases before expanding scope.
5. Revisit the plan when evidence changes.
Validate estimates with a small trial; a plan is an assumption, not a guarantee.

A team has 8 tasks and completes 2 per hour. Estimate the minimum hours and explain your assumptions briefly.
At a constant rate with no interruptions, the team needs 4 hours. If work is scheduled only in whole-hour blocks, allow 4 blocks. Check whether setup time and dependencies change that estimate.
A team has 21 tasks and completes 2 per hour. Estimate the minimum hours and explain your assumptions briefly.
At a constant rate with no interruptions, the team needs 10.5 hours. If work is scheduled only in whole-hour blocks, allow 11 blocks. Check whether setup time and dependencies change that estimate.
